verdicts.note: Evidence is one platform line favoring permitting reform and market incentives over state mandates [S3][S4]; no stated skepticism of rent regulation or broader deregulation agenda, and the 'no tenant-protection proposals' part of the basis is an absence of evidence. She also sits on the South King Housing and Homelessness Partners board [S1]. -2 (fully pole_a) is overstated; -1 matches the evidence and the -1 given to Cooke on comparable housing evidence in LD47 Pos 2.
